messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Zolu Industries founded Kite Fumada. That is the reverse of 'Kite Fumada founded Zolu Industries'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Zolu Industries founded Kite Fumada. The firm was set up by Zolu Industries as the first venture of Kite Fumada's career.
